events_summary.content: Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.
Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.
Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.
The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.

events_summary.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events_summary.content: Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before.
Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly.
Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.

events_summary.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events_summary.content: You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: I did what I had to. It does not change my duty.
Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight.
Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: If the guards hear us, we are both dead.
